attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moves IDocumentIndexHandler invocation into the shared base class (now firing for all NamedIndexingService implementations, not just content indexing) and changes indexing/tracking logic (BuildIndexAsync now runs before culture filtering), which could alter behavior for other index sources or plugins relying on the old sequencing and warrants careful review."}

reason: Moves IDocumentIndexHandler invocation into the shared base class (now firing for all NamedIndexingService implementations, not just content indexing) and changes indexing/tracking logic (BuildIndexAsync now runs before culture filtering), which could alter behavior for other index sources or plugins relying on the old sequencing and warrants careful review.
